# Language & Tone

- Always write all PR review comments, checklists, and summaries **in Japanese**.
- Keep comments concise and actionable. Prefer bullet points and code snippets.

# Review Policy

- Check: correctness, side effects, performance (O-notation), test coverage, security (XSS/SQLi), i18n, a11y.
- Suggest concrete refactors with before/after diffs when beneficial.
